headline: Stable branch fixes PAL level 11's Enhanced lighting bake
summary: PAL level 11 can bake all 254 lighting regions after a clearance fix (#189). Unlike this branch's usual release pull request from develop, today's change is a direct fix, with no launcher release in the snapshot. The baker now checks paths in both directions so an obstacle cannot leave an invalid connection in its lighting graph.
highlights: The related PAL level 11 bake issue #173 was closed as completed; the separate lighting-region-limit issue #159 was also closed as completed.
